name: cs_plate
author: coldsoldr
description: coldsoldr's plate reverb (Dattorro's figure-of-eight plate in fixed point, te-op1-cfw ports/fx/src/plate at 9ced415, GPL-3.0-or-later with the OP-1 firmware permission; the half-rate path from te-op1-cfw's Clouds port, MIT, Emilie Gillet) as a coop stereo effect, ported from its unreleased kennel build (ports/knl/cs_plate). Blue decay, green damp, white pre-delay, orange mix; fn + blue size (8 steps), fn + green diffusion, fn + white motion (shift + fn for fine); orange click freezes the tail.
